description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods—Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS—on a task evaluated by a metric labeled “Average Performance,” which ranges from 0 to 60 along the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the five methods in that order, with each represented by a distinct colored bar: Standard (tan), Self-RAG (olive), FactTune (green), CInGS (w/) (steel blue), and CInGS (dark blue). All bars reach approximately the 50–60 range, with CInGS achieving the highest performance at roughly 59, followed closely by CInGS (w/) at about 54, Self-RAG at 53, Standard at 52, and FactTune at 51. The chart visually emphasizes CInGS as the top-performing method, with performance increasing from left to right across the methods, suggesting incremental improvements with each subsequent approach. The background includes horizontal dashed gridlines at intervals of 10 to aid in value estimation.
